mapper.sql: ID AS id, EMAIL AS email, PASSWORD AS password, USERNAME AS username, ADDRESS AS address, PHONE_NUMBER AS phoneNumber, ROLE AS role, STATUS AS status, CAST(CREATED_AT AS TIMESTAMP) AS createdAt, CAST(UPDATED_AT AS TIMESTAMP) AS updatedAt, CAST(LEAVE_DATE AS TIMESTAMP) AS leaveDate, -- ✅ 추가 PROVIDER AS provider, PROVIDER_ID AS providerId
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MP_USER WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MP_USER ( ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, USERNAME, ADDRESS, PHONE_NUMBER, ROLE, STATUS, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( MP_USER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{email}, #{password}, #{username}, NVL(#{address}, ' '), NVL(#{phoneNumber}, ' '), 'USER', 'ACTIVE', 'MYPLATE', NULL, SYSTIMESTAMP )

SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(CAST(RATING AS NUMBER(10,2))), 1), 0) FROM MP_REVIEW WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MP_BOOKMARK WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'true'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT r.ID AS id, r.RESTAURANT_ID AS restaurantId, m.NAME AS restaurantName, r.RATING AS rating, -- COMMENT 컬럼 쓰지 않음 (스키마에 없거나 예약어 충돌) -- createdAt은 문자열로 포매팅해서 반환 TO_CHAR(r.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM MP_REVIEW r LEFT JOIN MP_RESTAURANT m ON m.ID = r.RESTAURANT_ID WHERE r.USER_ID = ( SELECT u.ID FROM MP_USER u WHERE LOWER(u.EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email}) ) AND r.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC ) t WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT r.ID AS restaurantId, r.NAME AS name, r.ADDRESS AS roadAddress, r.AVG_RATING AS avgRating, NVL(r.RATING_COUNT, 0) AS reviewCount, b.CREATED_AT AS bookmarkedAt FROM MP_BOOKMARK b JOIN MP_USER u ON u.ID = b.USER_ID JOIN MP_RESTAURANT r ON r.ID = b.RESTAURANT_ID WHERE u.EMAIL = #{email} AND b.STATUS = 'true' AND b.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY b.CREATED_AT DESC

WITH months AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),-(LEVEL-1)),'YYYY-MM') AS YM, ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),-(LEVEL-1)) AS MONTH_START FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{months} ), review_agg AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(r.CREATED_AT,'MM'),'YYYY-MM') AS YM, COUNT(*) AS REVIEW_COUNT, ROUND(AVG(r.RATING), 2) AS AVG_RATING FROM MP_REVIEW r WHERE r.USER_ID = #{userId} AND r.CREATED_AT >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),-(#{months}-1)) AND r.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND (r.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' OR r.STATUS IS NULL) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRUNC(r.CREATED_AT,'MM'),'YYYY-MM') ), bookmark_agg AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(b.CREATED_AT,'MM'),'YYYY-MM') AS YM, COUNT(*) AS BOOKMARK_COUNT FROM MP_BOOKMARK b WHERE b.USER_ID = #{userId} AND b.CREATED_AT >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),-(#{months}-1)) AND b.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND (b.STATUS = 'true' OR b.STATUS IS NULL) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRUNC(b.CREATED_AT,'MM'),'YYYY-MM') ) SELECT m.YM, NVL(r.REVIEW_COUNT, 0) AS REVIEW_COUNT, r.AVG_RATING AS AVG_RATING, -- 리뷰 없으면 null NVL(b.BOOKMARK_COUNT, 0) AS BOOKMARK_COUNT FROM months m LEFT JOIN review_agg r ON r.YM = m.YM LEFT JOIN bookmark_agg b ON b.YM = m.YM ORDER BY m.MONTH_START
